note: What moves each multi-gauge regular map from one phase to the next, in phase order. Hand-maintained; `kcnav normalize` joins it with KCNav's phase boundaries into map_gauge_phases.json. `defeats` is how many boss kills empty the phase's gauge, `reach` a node whose arrival opens the next phase, `s_rank_at` a node that must also have been won with an S rank, `key` the variant name where it is not `phase<N>`. Every map here refills on the first of the month and starts over from its first phase. Sources, read 2026-10-07: wikiwiki.jp/kancolle (南方海域/5-6) and zekamashi.net/kancolle-kouryaku (5-6, 7-2, 7-5), agreeing with murasame.blog.jp (7-2, 7-3) and kyuku9999.livedoor.blog (7-2, 7-3, 5-6).

5-6.note: Provisional. The real gauge is a transport gauge of 280 TP, emptied by A or S ranks at G; transport points are not modelled yet.
